title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
summary: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
summary: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
summary: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
summary: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
summary: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
summary: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

title: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack
summary: North Korean hackers previously used THORChain to move funds stolen from Bybit and Bitget, prompting calls for the protocol to intervene.

title: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
summary: Trezor urged customers who bought devices from CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected hardware implant.

title: Live updates: Binance uncovers more breach points in $6.3B hack
summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
summary: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

title: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
summary: TRM Labs says it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.

title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
summary: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick says the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
summary: Binance says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

title: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers After Report of Hardware Implant in Safe 5
summary: The hardware wallet manufacturer has yet to examine the device, but is treating the report as credible and told buyers to move their funds.

title: Binance Finds 'Additional Points of Breach' in $6.3B Hack
summary: CEO Richard Teng said the attack was "not a single 'one-click' action," as Binance confirmed about $3 billion has been frozen.

title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
summary: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.

title: Binance Drained of $5.5 Billion in Suspected Hack, Tether and Circle Freeze $1.8 Billion
summary: An on-chain tally puts the suspected Binance drain at $5.57 billion across three blockchains, as Tether and Circle froze $1.8 billion.

title: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
summary: Coinbase reported third-quarter net income of $719 million, driven largely by gains on its crypto holdings, as revenue held flat at $1.22 billion.

title: Chrome Can Now Pull Details From Your Gmail to Fill Out Web Forms
summary: Chrome's new autofill uses Google's Gemini AI to search your Gmail for order numbers, tracking details, and flight bookings and fill them into web forms. It is rolling out in the U.S.

title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
summary: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
summary: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

title: Coinbase Q3 net income jumps 66% as prediction markets gain traction
summary: Bernstein analysts said Coinbase's expanding prediction markets and derivatives businesses helped offset weaker spot trading activity.

title: Trezor reports suspected hardware implant in Safe 5 sold by CryptoBilis
summary: Trezor urged CryptoBilis buyers to migrate funds after receiving a credible report of a hardware implant inside a Safe 5 device.

title: Bitcoin slides below $77,000, BNB drops amid Binance hack
summary: BNB lost 7.1%, while Binance Co-CEO Yi He pledged that the exchange will cover all user losses resulting from the hack.

title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets. Binance says it is investigating.

title: Strategy reports $19.5 billion in Q3 net income as preferred shareholders approve daily dividends
summary: Strategy reported $19.53B in Q3 net income on a $20.91B bitcoin gain, holds 848,517 BTC, and moves preferreds to daily dividends.

title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.

title: Uniswap Labs opens fee conversion tool TJAR to apps, starting with Robinhood
summary: Uniswap Labs has opened up its Token Jar fee conversion system to other apps through a new tool called TJAR.
